title: Pivotal coordinate
statement: For a function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\beta$, a coordinate $i$, and a sign vector $x$, the coordinate $i$ is pivotal for $f$ at $x$ if $f(x)$ differs from the value of $f$ at the vector obtained by flipping coordinate $i$ of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps sign vectors of length $n$ to a type $\beta$
$i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
